info.name: SID knowhub Token - credential-free request template
info.description: Structure copied from the SID administrator's successful curl. No actual Basic credentials or authorization code are included. Import does not execute a request. Supply credentials locally through an approved protected mechanism. Use only a new, unconsumed code; never reuse a KnowHub callback code already exchanged by the backend. No tests or scripts persist responses.

request.description: No client_secret or code_verifier in the form, matching the supplied curl. Authorization is an explicit template header; no second Basic helper should be enabled. No real credentials are stored in this collection.
